reviewer.critique: The automated check failure 'NO_KNOWLEDGE_SEARCH' indicates that the employer's scoring policy in the knowledge base was not consulted during the assessment. This is a mandatory step per the rules. The screener must search the knowledge base for the employer's specific scoring guidelines, policy on qualification equivalency, and any other relevant assessment criteria before finalizing scores. All six criteria received maximum scores (3/3) without any knowledge-base references, which suggests the policy check was bypassed. Resubmit with evidence that the knowledge base was searched for scoring policy.
concerns: No knowledge-base references despite availability - mandatory policy check not performed
All criteria scored maximum (3/3) without comparative benchmark - suggests assessment may not align with employer's actual scoring standards
Essential criteria E2 and D2 may require policy verification for acceptance of stated experience as equivalent to formal qualification
